name: What are the most common hidden problems found during interior remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What hidden problems are most commonly discovered during an interior remodel in older homes?
mainEntity.text: What hidden problems are most commonly discovered during an interior remodel in older homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden conditions are one of the biggest reasons interior remodels run over budget or over schedule. In older homes, contractors often uncover outdated electrical, aging plumbing, water intrusion, termite damage, damaged subflooring, uneven framing, or prior repairs that were done poorly. Sometimes the biggest surprise is that previous remodeling was unpermitted or not built to current standards. These discoveries are hard to predict without opening walls, which is why contingency money matters. Homeowners should expect some level of unknowns, especially in older Los Angeles homes. The best protection is a clear change-order process, realistic allowances, and enough contingency to handle repair work without stopping the project entirely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common hidden problems include outdated wiring, old plumbing, water damage, termite damage, uneven framing, insufficient insulation, and previous unpermitted work. These issues often appear after demolition when walls or floors are opened. A contingency budget and flexible schedule help absorb the impact.
